The Einstein Fellowship 2022-23, Germany is an initiative by the Einstein Forum and the Daimler and Benz Foundation

for outstanding young thinkers who wish to pursue a project in a different field from that of their previous research. The purpose of the fellowship is to support those who are interested to produce outstanding work in their area of specialization and interdisciplinary approaches - following the example set by Albert Einstein. The selected fellow will receive a stipend of EUR 10,000 and other benefits.
To be eligible, the applicant must -
Be outstanding young thinkers who wish to pursue a project in a different field from that of their previous research
Hold a university degree in humanities, social sciences, or natural sciences
The selected fellow will receive the following benefits -
Living accommodation for 5-6 months in the garden cottage of Einstein's own summerhouse in Caputh, Brandenburg

The students will be selected based on the quality, originality, and feasibility of the proposed project, as well as the superior intellectual development of the applicant.
No fellowships will be given for dissertation research.

It is not relevant whether the applicant has begun working toward, or currently holds, a PhD. The proposed project need not be entirely completed during the time of the fellowship but can be the beginning of a longer project.
At the end of the fellowship period, the fellow will be expected to present his or her project in a public lecture at the Einstein Forum and the Wittenstein Foundation.
The Einstein Fellowship is not intended for applicants who wish to complete an academic study they have already begun.
The proposed project must be significantly projecting different in content and preferably field and form, from the applicant's previous work.
1. What kind of projects can I propose?
Your proposed project must not be part of your dissertation or thesis, and the
application documents must be in English

. Otherwise, there are no limitations on the project you may propose as long as you can defend your idea as interesting, original, and feasible during the fellowship period. Please also consider whether the facilities available to you here would suitably allow you to pursue your project.
The fellowship is awarded for just one project. As such, we recommend focusing on strengthening just one proposal.
